trace.final:
Done. Summary of what happened:

**Issue:** checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back** checkout-api to **v2.3.0** — the most recent release healthy in production — across all production regions.
2. **Verified recovery:** the service is now reporting healthy with a 0.2% error rate.
3. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** (titled "checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0") documenting the rollback and resolution; the on-call engineer has been paged.
